skill.summary: Build and interpret Ryanair fare-finder URLs for cheap flight searches. Use when the user wants to find budget flights from a specific UK airport, configure...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Ryanair Fare Finder skill.

- Build and interpret Ryanair fare-finder URLs for UK budget flight searches.
- Supports all query parameters: airport codes, date ranges, time windows, days of week, stay duration, passenger numbers, price limits, currency, and promo codes.
- Enables configuration for overnight or multi-night trips, outbound/return time slots, and flexible or specific travel dates.
- Includes example URL and detailed parameter reference for easy setup.
- Requires network access to ryanair.com fare-finder.
